note: A log.declaration-key event (errata G67, R6.62): the operator publishes the declaration key, a fixed P-256 test key whose kid is the RFC 7638 thumbprint of its public key, as { kid, jwk, valid_from } in the aggregate log:declaration-keys. It is the entry that precedes every declaration in the lifecycle cases (key-compromised-entry and compromise-*), and it is no lifecycle act: it ends no agent's key. The canonical form and the leaf are the frozen ones. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
